name: Comprehensive API Security Audit
description: A step-by-step workflow to audit an API for common vulnerabilities including Auth Bypass, IDOR, and Injection.

steps.name: Reconnaissance & Endpoint Discovery
steps.description: Map out the API surface using passive crawls and documentation.
steps.promptTemplate: Use Burp Suite MCP to passively crawl the target https://example.com/api. Identify all visible endpoints and structure a sitemap.

steps.name: Authentication Bypass Testing
steps.description: Attempt to access protected endpoints without credentials.
steps.promptTemplate: For the identified endpoints, attempt to access /api/v1/users and /api/v1/admin without any Authorization header. Record any 200 OK responses.

steps.name: Privilege Escalation (IDOR)
steps.description: Test for horizontal logic flaws by swapping user IDs.
steps.promptTemplate: Using the authenticated session of User A (ID: 123), try to request details for User B (ID: 456) at endpoint GET /api/v1/users/456.

steps.name: Input Validation Fuzzing
steps.description: Test injection vulnerabilities on input parameters.
steps.promptTemplate: Fuzz the 'q' parameter in GET /api/v1/search?q=test with common SQL injection and XSS payloads. Analyze responses for errors or reflections.
